pairs.gold_text: Yelverton Minerals and the independent panel revised its policy during the later response.
pairs.system_text: The operator revised its policy, and Yelverton Minerals and the independent panel revised its policy following the Ashfell slide.

pairs.gold_text: Yelverton Minerals and mines inspectorate met during the later response.
pairs.system_text: Yelverton Minerals and the mines inspectorate met on March 19.

pairs.gold_text: Ashfell slide damaged the lower road.
pairs.system_text: The Ashfell slide damaged the lower road in Dreth, and damage occurred in Dreth and the Pellan.

unmatched_gold.text: Damage was reported in Dreth and the Pellan during the Ashfell slide.

pairs.gold_text: The operator restored the lower road during the Ashfell slide.
pairs.system_text: The lower road was restored by March 19.

pairs.gold_text: Service at Corvane mine was disrupted during the Ashfell slide.
pairs.system_text: Service was disrupted in the Ashfell bench, at the mine, at the pit, at Corvane mine, and at the lower road.

unmatched_gold.text: Service at the lower road was disrupted during the Ashfell slide.

pairs.gold_text: 60 households were displaced from Cranmoor during evacuation and displacement operations.
pairs.system_text: 60 households were displaced from Cranmoor and moved away from Cranmoor due to the landslide.

pairs.gold_text: About 60 households were evacuated from Withel terraces during evacuation and displacement operations.
pairs.system_text: About 60 households were evacuated from Withel terraces, and people were evacuated from Withel terraces, Cranmoor, the bench, and the upper bench as part of evacuation efforts.

unmatched_gold.text: People were evacuated from Ashfell bench during evacuation and displacement operations.

unmatched_system.text: Warnings were issued for Withel terraces and Cranmoor, and evacuations were carried out from Withel terraces, Cranmoor, and the bench.
Information was provided about the tailings pond and the Corvane tailings dam.

pairs.gold_text: A warning was issued for Withel terraces and Cranmoor during emergency communications.
pairs.system_text: A warning was issued for Withel terraces and Cranmoor.
